tbd_q2_02.notes: k=4 showed observed stability behavior under tested procedure; no pre-ratified acceptance threshold established.

tbd_q2_04.justification: No independent empirical calibration or architectural contract has established w_fb. Inventing an arbitrary gain would violate research governance and create an unscientific pseudo-result. C2 comparative execution is strictly BLOCKED.

surrogate_analysis.interpretation: theta_95 defines the empirical 95th-percentile reference under the pseudo-synchrony surrogate null. Exceeding it does not prove genuine attunement.

C2_bidirectional_adaptation.reason: Feedback gain w_fb unestablished from independent calibration.

H_A_reactive_sufficiency.evidence: Unilateral adaptation (C1) produced an observed 0.4% variance reduction over static pacing (C0; 2566.25 vs 2576.63 ms²). Universal sufficiency is not claimed.

H_B_reciprocal_incrementality.evidence: C2 comparative run was not executed because w_fb cannot be invented without independent calibration. No claim of incrementality or falsification is made.

H_C_persistence.evidence: Within-episode P1/P2 tracking demonstrated; cross-session P3 persistence was not established by this experiment and remains untested pending a valid longitudinal protocol.

H_D_substrate_sufficiency.evidence: This experiment does not establish whether existing memory, semantic, or relational substrates are sufficient for P3 persistence. No new persistent relational representation is warranted.
